get_content.name: get_content
get_content.description: Get content from your Total CMS website

type.description: The type of data to return

slug.description: The CMS ID of the content to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Reads a single Total CMS content item by its CMS ID, where the content type is one of blog, datastore, date, depot, feed, file, gallery, image, ratings, text, toggle, or video. Use to fetch the current value of a known CMS field before displaying or updating it. Requires both the content type and the exact CMS ID (slug); read-only and idempotent.

get_blog_post.name: get_blog_post
get_blog_post.description: Get a blog post from Total CMS

slug.description: The CMS ID of the content to retrieve

permalink.description: The permalink of the post to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Reads a single blog post from a Total CMS blog, identified by the blog CMS ID (slug) plus the post permalink. Use to retrieve an existing post when you already know its permalink. Read-only and idempotent.

save_blog_post.name: save_blog_post
save_blog_post.description: Save blog content to Total CMS

slug.description: The CMS ID of the content to save

permalink.description: The permalink of the blog post. Ensure this is unique or it will overwrite the existing post.

title.description: The title of the blog post

timestamp.description: The date in unix timestamp format

summary.description: The summary of the blog post

content.description: The content of the blog post

extra.description: The extra content of the blog post

extra2.description: The extra content 2 of the blog post

media.description: The media of the blog post

rssTitle.description: The RSS title of the blog post

rssDescription.description: The RSS description of the blog post

author.description: The author of the blog post

genre.description: The genre of the blog post

categories.description: A comma separated list of categories for the blog post

tags.description: A comma separated list of tags for the blog post

labels.description: A comma separated list of labels for the blog post

draft.description: Set to true to save as a draft

featured.description: Set to true to save as a featured post

archived.description: Set to true to save as an archived post

aiMetadata.description: Creates or overwrites a blog post in a Total CMS blog, identified by the blog CMS ID (slug) plus a permalink, writing fields such as title, summary, content, author, categories, tags, and draft/featured/archived flags. Use to publish or edit a post. The permalink is the post key: reusing an existing permalink overwrites that post rather than creating a new one, so repeating the call with the same permalink and values is idempotent.

save_blog_gallery.name: save_blog_gallery
save_blog_gallery.description: Save image to Total CMS blog post gallery

slug.description: The CMS ID of the blog to save

permalink.description: The permalink of the blog post to save

alt.description: The alt text for the image

scaleSq.description: The scale of the square thumbnail

resize.description: The method to use when resizing the thumbnail

lcrop.description: The method to use when cropping the landscape thumbnail for the square thumbnail

pcrop.description: The method to use when cropping the landscape thumbnail for the square thumbnail

altMeta.displayName: Pull Alt Text from Meta Data
altMeta.description: Pull the alt text from the meta data of the image. If set, place placeholder text in the alt text field above.

aiMetadata.description: Uploads an image into the gallery of a specific blog post in Total CMS, identified by the blog CMS ID (slug) and post permalink, with alt text and thumbnail sizing/crop options. Use to add a photo to a post gallery. Not idempotent: each call appends another image to the gallery.

save_blog_image.name: save_blog_image
save_blog_image.description: Save image to Total CMS blog post

slug.description: The CMS ID of the content to save

permalink.description: The permalink of the blog post to save

alt.description: The alt text for the image

scaleSq.description: The scale of the square thumbnail

resize.description: The method to use when resizing the thumbnail

lcrop.description: The method to use when cropping the landscape thumbnail for the square thumbnail

pcrop.description: The method to use when cropping the landscape thumbnail for the square thumbnail

altMeta.displayName: Pull Alt Text from Meta Data
altMeta.description: Pull the alt text from the meta data of the image. If set, place placeholder text in the alt text field above.

aiMetadata.description: Sets the featured/main image of a specific blog post in Total CMS, identified by the blog CMS ID (slug) and post permalink, with alt text and thumbnail sizing/crop options. Use to attach or replace a post's primary image. Idempotent: the post holds one such image, so repeating with the same input replaces it rather than accumulating.

save_date.name: save_date
save_date.description: Save date content to Total CMS

slug.description: The CMS ID of the content to save

aiMetadata.description: Sets a date-type CMS field in Total CMS, identified by its CMS ID (slug), to a given Unix timestamp. Use to write or update a stored date value. Idempotent: the value is keyed on the slug, so repeating with the same timestamp leaves the same result.

save_depot.name: save_depot
save_depot.description: Save file to Total CMS depot

slug.description: The CMS ID of the depot to save

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a file into a Total CMS depot (a multi-file collection), identified by the depot CMS ID (slug). Use to add a document or asset to a depot. Not idempotent: each call appends another file to the depot.

slug.description: The CMS ID of the file to save

ext.description: The file extension of the file

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a single file to a file-type CMS field in Total CMS, identified by its CMS ID (slug), with an explicit file extension. Use to set or replace the file stored at a given CMS ID. Idempotent: the field holds one file keyed on the slug, so repeating with the same input replaces it.

save_gallery.name: save_gallery
save_gallery.description: Save image to Total CMS gallery

slug.description: The CMS ID of the gallery to save

alt.description: The alt text for the image

scaleSq.description: The scale of the square thumbnail

resize.description: The method to use when resizing the thumbnail

lcrop.description: The method to use when cropping the landscape thumbnail for the square thumbnail

pcrop.description: The method to use when cropping the landscape thumbnail for the square thumbnail

altMeta.displayName: Pull Alt Text from Meta Data
altMeta.description: Pull the alt text from the meta data of the image. If set, place placeholder text in the alt text field above.

aiMetadata.description: Uploads an image into a gallery-type CMS field in Total CMS, identified by the gallery CMS ID (slug), with alt text and thumbnail sizing/crop options. Use to add a photo to a standalone gallery. Not idempotent: each call appends another image to the gallery.

slug.description: The CMS ID of the content to save

alt.description: The alt text for the image

scaleSq.description: The scale of the square thumbnail

resize.description: The method to use when resizing the thumbnail

lcrop.description: The method to use when cropping the landscape thumbnail for the square thumbnail

pcrop.description: The method to use when cropping the landscape thumbnail for the square thumbnail

altMeta.displayName: Pull Alt Text from Meta Data
altMeta.description: Pull the alt text from the meta data of the image. If set, place placeholder text in the alt text field above.

aiMetadata.description: Sets a single image-type CMS field in Total CMS, identified by its CMS ID (slug), with alt text, output extension (jpg/png), and thumbnail sizing/crop options. Use to set or replace the image stored at a given CMS ID. Idempotent: the field holds one image keyed on the slug, so repeating with the same input replaces it.

save_text.name: save_text
save_text.description: Save text content to Total CMS

slug.description: The CMS ID of the content to save

aiMetadata.description: Sets a text-type CMS field in Total CMS, identified by its CMS ID (slug), to the supplied text content. Use to write or update a stored text/HTML value. Idempotent: the value is keyed on the slug, so repeating with the same text leaves the same result.

save_toggle.name: save_toggle
save_toggle.description: Save toggle content to Total CMS

slug.description: The CMS ID of the content to save

status.description: The status of the toggle. "true" is on, "false" is off.

aiMetadata.description: Sets a toggle-type (boolean on/off) CMS field in Total CMS, identified by its CMS ID (slug), to the supplied true/false state. Use to flip a stored toggle. Idempotent: the state is keyed on the slug, so repeating with the same value leaves the same result.

save_video.name: save_video
save_video.description: Save video content to Total CMS

slug.description: The CMS ID of the content to save

video.description: The URL of the video to save

aiMetadata.description: Sets a video-type CMS field in Total CMS, identified by its CMS ID (slug), to a given video URL (must be a valid URL). Use to write or update the stored video reference. Idempotent: the value is keyed on the slug, so repeating with the same URL leaves the same result.

new_blog_post.description: Triggers when a new blog post is published

slug.description: The CMS ID of the content to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new blog post appears in the specified Total CMS blog (identified by its CMS ID). Polls the blog and emits one event per newly published post, deduplicated by permalink.
